newsitem.title: USA: Powerful cyclone Gretelle hits Madagascar - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Powerful cyclone Gretelle hits Madagascar - WSC.

text.p: LEXINGTON, Mass., Jan 24 (Reuter), - Tropical cyclone Gretelle is making landfall along the southeast coast of Madagascar with top winds estimated at 130 mph, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Friday.
Winds damage at coastal areas is likely to be quite high. It is also likely that a major storm surge is causing coastal flooding and considerable damage...especially north of the track.

Winds will weaken as the system moves inland but will still be strong enough to cause considerable damage. Rains of at least 7-15 inches will lead to massive flooding and severe mudslides as this system tracks inland. Damage could become extreme, especially due to flooding and mudslides, WSC added.
